sections.section_content: **Overhead Squat**: 3-3-3-3-3 reps

metadata.raw_content:

Post loads to comments.  
Compare to [210128](https://www.crossfit.com/210128).
___
**Scaling:**  
Heavy overhead squats challenge your strength while demanding solid mechanics and good flexibility. Athletes at all skill levels should attempt overhead squat triples. Experienced athletes can go as heavy as possible, while newer athletes will use this workout as an opportunity to drill the movement, potentially increasing the reps for more practice.

sections.section_content:
Complete as many reps as possible in 21 minutes of:

* **Run** (Distance varies by time window):
    * 0:00-7:00: 400 meters
    * 7:00-14:00: 200 meters
    * 14:00-21:00: 100 meters
* **Max-rep Strict Pull-ups**

*Note: Each time you break a set of pull-ups, complete the corresponding run.*
section_notes: Choose a pulling exercise that allows you to complete at least 10 reps unbroken in the early rounds.

metadata.raw_content:
Complete as many reps as possible in 21 minutes of:
 
Run 400/200/100 meters  
Max-rep strict pull-ups  
 
Each time you break a set of pull-ups, complete a run. From 0:00-7:00 run 400, from 7:00-14:00 run 200, and from 14:00-21:00 run 100. 
 
Post number of strict pull-ups completed each round to comments.
Compare to [210102](https://www.crossfit.com/210102).
___
**Scaling:**   
Choose a pulling exercise that is challenging but allows you to complete at least 10 reps unbroken in the early rounds. If at any point you cannot complete 3 reps unbroken, switch to an easier form of pull-up.
 
**Beginner Option:**  
Complete as many reps as possible in 14 minutes of:   
Jog 200 meters  
10 ring rows
